precondition: Borrower has voice consent on file; otherwise the executor blocks the call (no dial)

prompts.greeting: Namaste, main aapke lender ki taraf se Kairos assistant bol rahi hoon. Yeh call record ho rahi hai.
prompts.permission: Kya abhi aapke EMI ke baare mein do minute baat kar sakte hain?
prompts.declined: Koi baat nahi. Hum aapko WhatsApp par sampark karenge. Dhanyavaad.
prompts.ask_intent: Aap apni EMI ke baare mein kya batana chahenge?
prompts.unclear: Maaf kijiye, main samajh nahi paayi. Kya aap dobara bata sakte hain?
prompts.ask_date: Samajh gayi. Aap kis tareekh tak bhugtan kar payenge?
prompts.confirm_date: Theek hai, {date} tak. Hum tab tak reminder nahi bhejenge aur us din bhugtan check karenge.
prompts.no_date: Koi baat nahi. Hum do din baad WhatsApp par tareekh poochhenge.
prompts.ack_paid: Dhanyavaad. Hum aapka bhugtan verify karke WhatsApp par update denge.
prompts.ack_hardship: Mujhe sunkar dukh hua. Main aapka maamla ek senior sahyogi ko de rahi hoon, woh aapse sampark karenge.
prompts.ack_callback: Zaroor. Hamare pratinidhi aapko jald call karenge.
prompts.ack_stop: Theek hai, hum aapko is vishay par aur call nahi karenge.
prompts.goodbye_unresolved: Hum aapse WhatsApp par sampark karenge. Dhanyavaad.

steps: permission → declined ends call (DECLINED, no intent)
ask_intent (max 2 tries; unclear ends with no intent)
HARDSHIP → neutral ack + handoff, reason restricted
rules: Never speak amounts or loan numbers
Do not confirm a payment; D7/LMS decide
Do not repeat hardship details back

body.custom_ref: Kairos touch_id passed when the call is placed

callback.idempotency: one outcome per call_id; repeated completions are ignored
